The research program within which this position is embedded investigates how the brain encodes and generates social and emotional behaviors by examining the underlying neuronal mechanisms and neural circuits. The research requires the use of macaques housed in dedicated animal facilities, as only non-human primates with a brain organization closely resembling that of humans allow the development and validation of these methodologies. The overall goal is to advance our understanding of the neural processes underlying social and emotional interactions, with potential implications for improving the understanding and treatment of psychiatric and neurological disorders.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: The Constitution of Sense in Professional Postures: Towards a Phenomenologically Grounded New Epistemological Framework for Educational Processes and Contexts. (Univ. BARI)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-28 23:55
Institution: Univ. BARI, Bari
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PHIL-01 Filosofia teoretica

The project is situated within applied philosophy and aims to provide a theoretical foundation for innovation in education and training. It develops a phenomenological analysis of professional postures in workplace contexts, grounded in the transcendental phenomenology of Edmund Husserl and its contemporary developments. The study seeks to describe the structures of meaning constituting professional action within the Lebenswelt, clarifying their conditions of possibility. It thereby advances and validates the phenomenological approach as a theoretical and methodological framework for analysing educational and training contexts.
